comment: OUT 1 is the mixer, not a register stage: it is written only when the internal stage counter is at zero, which is every fourth clock (SquidAxon.cpp:72-93), and the maker's README makes the same point. The nonlinear feedback is OUT 4 times the knob, through a squared diode model, clamped to -9V to 9V and then multiplied by -0.7 before being added to the mix (SquidAxon.cpp:85-90). The three inputs are only read at a clock, so anything patched into them is sampled rather than followed.
